1 αὐτοὺς ('them') the codex has, I have corrected. τῶν ἡμῶν ('of ours') the codex has, corrected. 2 Κύων πρὸ ('Dog before') corrected by Boll : προ-
κύων ('Procyon') the codex has. 11 εὐδινός ('well-whirling') the codex has. 12 νοταπηλιώτης ('south-east wind') the codex has. πηγώδης ('spring-like') the codex has : πνιγώδης ('stifling')
corrected from Hephaestion, p. 52, 8. 13 ποεῖ ('makes') corrected : ἐπὶ ('upon') the codex has. 14 καθορᾶν ('to look down') the codex has. Cf. καταφορὰν ('downpour')

summary.headline: Gemini and Cancer Associations
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of Gemini and Cancer, including their associated constellations, gods, climatic and geographic regions, stars, planetary rulership, qualities, and effects on temperament and fate. Cancer’s assigned lands include Bactriana, Ethiopia, the Red and Hyrcanian seas, Britannia, Thule, Rhodes, Cos, and Troglodytia.
